title: ampelopsis bodinieri
intro: Ampelopsis bodinieri, commonly known as the Chinese grapevine, is a type of woody vine native to China. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The health benefits of Ampelopsis bodinieri include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antipyretic properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, pain, and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Ampelopsis bodinieri include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antipyretic effects.
